patch.objective: Modifying programs for special populations and changing health conditions
secondaryObjectives: Emergency response within scope of practice, incident documentation and facility safety

sources.cite: ACE Personal Trainer Exam Content Outline (2022 role delineation study; in effect since 2023-08-21): Client Interviews and Assessments 23%, Program Design and Implementation 31%, Program Progression and Modifications 27%, Professional Conduct, Safety and Risk Management 19%
sources.note: Relayed from the course seed (backend/supabase/seed/tracks/fitness.ts, read 2026-10-08), not re-read for this case. The objective titles are the course's own words.

sources.cite: Perinatology.com. Exercise in High-Risk Pregnancy (updated 2026, summarizing the 2019 Canadian guideline for physical activity throughout pregnancy, Mottola et al., and ACOG Committee Opinion 804)
sources.note: Read 2026-11-17 through a summarizing fetch of a secondary summary (the guidelines themselves were not read): stop and call the obstetric team for vaginal bleeding, fluid leakage, regular painful contractions, severe chest pain or persistent shortness of breath, persistent dizziness or faintness; modify lying flat if lightheaded; avoid contact sports, high fall-risk activities, scuba, Olympic lifts and exercise in excessive heat; moderate intensity by the talk test ('talk but not sing') and RPE.

That lying flat on the bench makes her lightheaded at 24 weeks, that her old program's intervals reach an effort where she cannot talk, and that fluid leakage with cramping begins 20 minutes in are authored for the case. Simplified teaching model written for exam practice; not a validated physiological model.
The objective and secondary objectives are the course's own titles.
